name: Site Web Directory

sources.title: Sites Web Directory - Submit Link (Step One: Choose a Category)
Sites Web Directory homepage - 'Find and List your URLS'

requirements: Legacy phpLD-style web directory: submission starts with 'Step One: Choose a Category' from a huge topical tree (Arts, Business and Trade, Computers and Internet, ..., Real Estate)
The submit flow is multi-step: category selection first, then listing details on a following step (fields not visible on step 1)
Open submission form - a login/register widget exists on the page but is not required to reach the form
Also has a separate 'Submit Article' article-directory flow
preparation: Site URL, title, and description (standard fields on the details step)
The correct deep category - pre-pick it; the tree is very long
Submitter name and email for the details step
workflow: Step 1: drill into and select the right category from the tree
Step 2 (after category selection): complete the listing details form and submit
Wait for review; check 'Latest Links' for the listing to appear
watchFor: Whether a paid 'featured' tier appears on step 2 is unverified - similar sibling directories (submissionwebdirectory, highrankdirectory) show a paid fast-review tier at this stage; proceed through the form and decline if offered
No stated review time on the submit page
Site is active (recent listings shown) but has legacy UX - no draft saving
countsAsLive: The URL is listed publicly under its chosen category (verify via 'Latest Links' or the category page)
unknowns: Whether a paid/featured option is presented on step 2 of the form
Whether an account is required on a later step
